\section{Math}
Inline dollars $a+b$ and parens \(c^2\) are kept as TeX.

The energy is
\begin{equation}
E = mc^2 \label{eq:energy}
\end{equation}
as in \eqref{eq:energy}.

Display brackets:
\[
  \sum_{i=1}^n i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\]

And double dollars:
$$\int_0^1 x\,dx = \tfrac12$$

\begin{align}
  f(x) &= x^2 \label{eq:f} \\
  g(x) &= 2x \nonumber \\
  h(x) &= x^3 \label{eq:h}
\end{align}

Unnumbered: \begin{equation*} a=b \end{equation*}
Tagged: \begin{equation} \tag{$\star$} c=d \end{equation}
Equation \ref{eq:h} and \eqref{eq:f}.
